name: KCM Church Portal - KeyFinder Security Policy & Exclusions
description: Narrowly scoped exclusions and classifications for third-party scripts, residual local development state, and benign UI state identified by KeyFinder v2.0.

rules.rationale: Residual browser web storage from an external developer workspace project ('Cinema Elk') sharing localhost:3000 origin. Not part of KCM Church codebase or deployments.
Residual Rudderstack/analytics telemetry cookie left on localhost:3000 by another application session. KCM Church exclusively uses 'kcm_session' HttpOnly cookie.
Next.js App Router and React runtime dynamic chunk loader function names and route cache keys incorrectly matched by keyword 'key'.
Residual browser cache/service worker token keyword from an unrelated project tested on the same local development port.
Standard Google search warmup client state, translation promo cache, and reCAPTCHA challenge tokens managed entirely within Google's origin.
Vercel preview toolbar infrastructure injection for deployment comments and feature flags. Exists only in development/preview environments and managed by Vercel platform.
Official YouTube public web player embed API key, player build version tags, and remote device pairing IDs loaded in sandboxed youtube.com iframes for sermon and worship video streaming.
Client-side WebSocket connection transport preference and timestamp cache stored by Pusher JS client for realtime sermon and chat updates.
User's chosen church branch ID (CUID) for filtering local announcements and events (e.g. Shapur, Subhash Nagar, Bahadurpally). Contains zero sensitive data.
Firebase Authentication SDK public error code dictionary strings bundled for client-side exception handling, matched by keyword rules 'client_id' and 'credential'.
Multilingual UI text strings (Telugu/Kannada) translating the labels 'Razorpay Key ID' and password strength error messages ('Password is too weak. Please choose a stronger one').
UI dark/light mode preference storage key used by next-themes provider. Stores only 'light', 'dark', or 'system'.
Google Account switcher and OneGoogle widget assets loaded when users interact with Google Identity Services.
Vercel deployment session cookie on an external developer portfolio site visited in the same browser profile.
